preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 3 and 300 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (1 <= k <= n**2 and all(3 <= len(cycle) <= 4 for cycle in cycles))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output -1. Otherwise, output the number of cycles k and each cycle must have a length of 3 or 4.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(cycle)) == len(cycle) for cycle in cycles)
postconditions.description: Each cycle must contain distinct vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(any(cycle[i] == edge[0] and cycle[(i+1) % len(cycle)] == edge[1] for cycle in cycles) for edge in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge must appear in exactly two cycles.
